title: Claude-assisted analytic proof establishes a+b=1 for mean-field jamming exponents
summary: Giorgio Parisi and Francesco Zamponi provide an analytic proof that the critical exponents a and b in the full replica-symmetry-breaking scaling solution for infinite-dimensional dense hard spheres obey a+b=1. The identity links gap, contact-force and overlap scaling relations and had previously been known numerically but not analytically. The authors report that Claude Opus 4.7 derived the core proof idea with minimal supervision, with Sonnet 4.6 helping refine it; the authors found and corrected errors in an early draft, then verified and edited the final proof.
ai_technology: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Sonnet 4.6
organization: Sapienza University of Rome; CNR-Nanotec Rome; INFN Sezione di Roma 1; Beihang University

evidence.tested: Giorgio Parisi and Francesco Zamponi provide an analytic proof that the critical exponents a and b in the full replica-symmetry-breaking scaling solution for infinite-dimensional dense hard spheres obey a+b=1.
evidence.unknown: The theorem is scoped to the fullRSB scaling equations for the infinite-dimensional dense hard-sphere jamming solution; it is not a general proof about every finite-dimensional jamming system. The result is peer-reviewed and published, but proof validation and correction are attributed to the human authors.
evidence.ai_role: After numerical investigation, Opus generated the analytic proof strategy and proof draft for the previously unproven scaling identity; Sonnet refined minor steps. The authors report 40 prompts, corrected early inconsistencies and verified/edited the published proof.
